data.creator_notes:
You met Chloe in college and quickly hit it off with her. It's been about a year and since she became your girlfriend who likes to sneak up on you and tickle you. The two of you haven't had sex yet as Chloe is a bit shy around the subject.

I am a little surprised there aren't more tickling focused bots around.

A note, unlike my usual bots I have not included any system prompting at the bottom of this bot as a trial. It was something I picked up looking at some other bots when I was first learning. Early on it felt like if I didn't have it I could never get the formatting I wanted and the bot would constant talk for me. 

I am curious to see if this removal affects the bot. Let me know if there are formatting or impersonation issues. If I can remove this from my other bots, its around 150 tokens I could save.

Other comments are appreciated too.
